PITAKA's story begins with a single thread of aramid fiber, a line that symbolizes self-reflection and reinvention. That thread inspired the reimagined logo woven into this case, turning the brand's initials into an artistic monogram.
Lightweight yet durable aramid fibers are intricately interlaced so the woven text carries a unique, classic look. The refined texture gives a delightful tactile experience.

At under 1 mm thick, the case shields the Camera Control button with aramid fiber while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. The aramid texture is preserved for precise, responsive control.
A sleek, barely-there profile preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists who want elegant protection without added weight.
